map.本工具用于检测（成分/纯度/环保）服务的合法性校验，依据对应数据格式与语法规范实: This tool validates the (composition / purity / eco-compliance) testing service against the corresponding data format and syntax rules in real time, locating errors; it runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
map.📚 深度解析：化工产品三项检测判定（成分/纯度/环保）: 📚 Deep Dive: Three-Item Test for Chemical Products (Composition / Purity / Eco-Compliance)
map.化工品进场自检：按成分符合率、纯度、环保达标率三项判定: Chemical incoming self-check: judge by three items — composition conformity, purity, eco-compliance rate
map.合规提示：环保达标率关系 RoHS/排放要求: Compliance note: eco-compliance rate relates to RoHS/emission requirements
map.逐项判定：成分符合率≥95%、纯度≥99.0%、环保达标率≥90%；三项均满足为: Item-by-item: composition conformity ≥ 95%, purity ≥ 99.0%, eco-compliance rate ≥ 90%; all three satisfied = pass. Composition conformity reflects consistency with the target formula.
map.成分符合率 96%（≥95 ✓）、纯度 99.2%（≥99.0 ✓）、环保 92: Composition conformity 96% (≥95 ✓), purity 99.2% (≥99.0 ✓), eco 92% (≥90 ✓): all three pass → qualified. If conformity drops to 93% it fails, formula drift.
map.成分符合率和纯度区别？: What is the difference between composition conformity and purity?
map.纯度是目标物质量占比，成分符合率是各组分比例与标准配方的一致度；两者都达标才代表: Purity is the mass fraction of the target substance; composition conformity is how closely each component ratio matches the standard formula. Both must pass to be both pure and correctly proportioned.
map.该值为示例合格线，对应一般限值；涉 RoHS/REACH 等须按具体有害物质清单: This value is an example pass line for general limits; for RoHS/REACH etc., each hazardous substance must be checked individually per its list — don't rely on the composite rate alone.
map.成分分析需对照标准配方确认各组分含量: Composition analysis must compare against the standard formula to confirm each component's content
map.环保检测需关注重金属、有害物质指标: Eco testing must focus on heavy-metal and hazardous-substance indicators
